title: Emberwild
tagline: Every road begins with a hearth.
description: Emberwild is a larger example world for the KithCore multiplayer RPG engine, with a mostly complete level 1–10 starting zone and Alderhaven, plus static geography for future content. Requires KithCore; choose the combined starter or install the world-only pack in a compatible engine.

features.title: The Cinderwood Reach
features.text: Follow a starting campaign from Hearthstead through woodland trails, the old sanctuary and outlying settlements. Explore the neighboring capital of Alderhaven.

features.title: An entire library to build with
features.text: Every generator stays available, including unused art. Ten equipment level bands have distinct shapes for cloth, leather, mail, plate and eleven weapon/offhand families. Apply regional palettes as additional drop variations.

features.title: A game package of its own
features.text: World definitions, race art, scenery and story live separately from the engine. Use the world-only release or a combined starter with a tested engine version.

features.title: A continent for future stories
features.text: Four interconnected leveling routes, five capitals and ten frontier landscapes. New regions have empty wayhouses, city architecture and clear encounter sites; later quests and populations remain to be authored.

features.title: Discover the roads, then fly
features.text: Visit flight stones on foot to unlock them. Fly between connected discovered stations or use portals between discovered capitals. Exploration records persist with your character.

features.title: Four independent disciplines
features.text: Dawnwardens fight in melee, Pathfinders hunt with bows, Arcanists control and damage from range, and Stormcallers heal and protect allies while retaining solo lightning attacks.

features.title: Ecology before encounters
features.text: 208 creature designs and 32 body shapes support 52 zone rosters. Each roster has a backstory and five creature types, with a population plan of twenty. New regions remain unpopulated until encounters are authored.

features.title: Explore an organized world
features.text: Five top-level atlas regions use adjoining geographic boundaries and short terrain-led maps. An opt-in local developer entrance provides an explorer with every travel destination unlocked.

scenes.title: The first hearth
scenes.description: The starting camp in Cinderwood: shelter, familiar faces and the first road north.

scenes.title: Fourwinds Exchange
scenes.description: Alderhaven's market ward, built from the same source-defined scenery and shared world systems.

scenes.title: Lantern Gardens
scenes.description: The capital's gardens and guest pavilions show how the larger demo extends beyond the starting zone.

scenes.title: Sylvarin, the Listening Crown
scenes.description: Radial garden wards, living-wood halls and a vast open crown pavilion. Unpopulated static geography for future content.

scenes.title: Nereides, the Returning Harbor
scenes.description: Crescent harbor wards, shell-domed halls and an open rescue quay. Unpopulated static geography for future content.

scenes.title: The World Anvil
scenes.description: Basalt organ pipes around a huge terraced impact forge. Unpopulated static geography for future content.

scenes.title: The Broken Orrery
scenes.description: A field of nested impact basins beneath a monumental broken astronomical ring. Unpopulated static geography for future content.
